cards.name: Legendary Sword
cards.description: A sword that brings out the best in warriors. It cannot be used by servants of the dark.

cards.name: Sword of Dark Destruction
cards.description: Dark forces increase the power of Warriors.

cards.name: Dark Energy
cards.description: Dark forces increase the power of Fiends and other monsters of the Dark!

cards.name: Axe of Despair
cards.description: Fiends and Beast-Warriors can constantly use their maximum strength!

cards.name: Laser Cannon Armor
cards.description: Arms insects with a powerful laser!

cards.name: Insect Armor with Laser Cannon
cards.description: Allows Insects to fire an intense blast of fire!

cards.name: Elf's Light
cards.description: Increases the power of elves with mystical light!

cards.name: Beast Fangs
cards.description: Increases the power of Beasts and other fanged monsters!

cards.name: Steel Shell
cards.description: Boosts the power of shelled monsters! said to have no effect on those without shells.

cards.name: Vile Germs
cards.description: Vile microbes boosts the power of Plants in the woods!

cards.name: Black Pendant
cards.description: This pendant grants extra power to Dark sorcerers!

cards.name: Silver Bow and Arrow
cards.description: Silver bow and arrow enhances the power of Fairies.

cards.name: Horn of Light
cards.description: Increases the power of horned creatures! Has no effect on Dark monsters.

cards.name: Horn of the Unicorn
cards.description: Increases the power of Dark monsters with horns!

cards.name: Dragon Treasure
cards.description: A legendary treasure that increases the power of dragons.

cards.name: Electro-whip
cards.description: A whip for paralyzing enemies. Increases power when equipped with female creatures.

cards.name: Cyber Shield
cards.description: Increases the power of female monsters by changing their attitudes.

cards.name: Elegant Egotist
cards.description: Creates the doppelgangers of Harpie Lady for three-pronged attacks!

cards.name: Mystical Moon
cards.description: Moonlight increases the power of Beasts!

cards.name: Malevolent Nuzzler
cards.description: Diabolic forces act to increase the power of female and Dark monsters!

cards.name: Violet Crystal
cards.description: Mystic forces from the crystal increase the power of Zombies.

cards.name: Book of Secret Arts
cards.description: A magic book for increasing the power of magic-users. It cannot be used by bad-hearted sorcerers.

cards.name: Invigoration
cards.description: Increases the power of Thunder, Rock, and Pyro monsters!

cards.name: Machine Conversion Factory
cards.description: A manufacturing facility that tunes up all Machine monsters.

cards.name: Raise Body Heat
cards.description: Absorbs the sun's energy to increase the power of Dinosaurs!

cards.name: Follow Wind
cards.description: The winds provide support to increase the power of Winged Beasts and other flying monsters!

cards.name: Power of Kaishin
cards.description: Poseidon's strength is shared to boost the power of Aqua, Fish, and Sea Serpent monsters!

cards.name: Kunai with Chain
cards.description: A boomerang featuring the effects of two cards: the Legendary Sword and the Sword of Dark Destruction.

cards.name: Magical Labyrinth
cards.description: A card for boosting the power of the Labyrinth Wall.

cards.name: Salamandra
cards.description: Increases the strength of those who control the power of Salamandra.

cards.name: Megamorph
cards.description: A card that increases the power of any selected monster by 2 levels.

cards.name: Metalmorph
cards.description: A card that changes any selected monster to a Machine monster.

cards.name: Winged Trumpeter
cards.description: A horn that increases the power of fairy creatures.

cards.name: Bright Castle
cards.description: A glaring light that increases the power of all monsters.
